name: offer
task_message:
You just made this proposal: {{offer_text}} (item_ref {{offer_ref}}). If the customer accepts it or names an amount and date allowed by the facts, read back item, amount and date, wait for a clear yes, then call create_promise. Never make another proposal yourself: the next one comes automatically after a refusal. When the call is over, say goodbye and call end_call.

Facts:
{{facts_text}}

After every tool result, either speak to the customer or call the next tool: never end a turn with nothing. Call one tool per message. Follow what_to_do_next in a tool result.

function.name: create_promise
function.description: Record one promise. CALL it only after the customer said yes to the read-back.

item_ref.description: item_ref of the proposal, copied unchanged.

amount_minor.description: Amount in currency units as read back, e.g. 412.50.

function.name: end_call
function.description: Ends the call. CALL it right after you said goodbye, with no other text.

extraction_schema.name: offer_answer
extraction_schema.description: refused when the customer says no to the proposal just made, without naming an amount or date of their own; else stay.
